# kit-a

> A free, browser-based editor for system architecture diagrams. Drag, connect, label, export. No account required — everything is saved locally in your browser.

kit-a is a node-based canvas for designing system architectures: drag components, connect them with labeled animated links, and export to image or JSON. It runs entirely in the browser with no backend and no sign-up.

## Links

- [kit-a](https://kit-a.com/): The architecture diagram editor

## Features

- 14 node types: Client, Server, Database, API, Auth, Queue, Cache, Cloud, Bucket, Function, Monitor, Mobile, Web App, Group
- 1,800+ cloud service icons: AWS, Azure, GCP, Microsoft 365, and more
- Smart connections: labeled, colored, directional or bidirectional with animated flow
- 6 architecture templates: 3-Tier Web App, Microservices, Event-Driven, Auth Flow, Auth0 Integration, CI/CD Pipeline
- Export formats: PNG (up to 3x), JPG, animated GIF, PDF; export/import as JSON
- Local browser storage: save named designs and restore your working canvas automatically
- Completely free, no account required
